title: Why Leon Kennedy never had a choice in Resident Evil 4
subject: leon
description:
Would you have taken the deal? 👇

What happened to Leon S. Kennedy and Sherry Birkin after Raccoon City. Spoilers for Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 4.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Leon Kennedy never chose to become a government agent.
After escaping Raccoon City, he and the orphaned Sherry Birkin were taken into US government custody.
Sherry carried the G-virus in her blood, which made her too valuable to let go.
Then Leon was asked to join a secret program. In his own words, he didn't have a choice.
But that's not the darkest part. Fans believe Sherry's safety was the price of his cooperation.
Years of brutal training later, his first big mission was rescuing the President's daughter.
The hero everyone admires still carries one quiet truth:
